description: This week, we are looking at the digital identity in society. Article to annotate:  Jose, J. (2025). Theorising Identities in Digital Space: Filters, Avatars and Evolving Ludic Cultures. Digital Crossroads: Integrating Humanities, Science and Technology Edition 1, 62-71
This week, we are looking at Chomsky's Propaganda Model.

This week, we explore the role of AI. Article to annotate: Cheng, M., Lee, C., Khadpe, P., Yu, S., Han, D., & Jurafsky, D. (2026). Sycophantic AI decreases prosocial intentions and promotes dependence. Science, 391

This week, we explore the role of new media in shaping mass communication. Article to annotate: Maynard, D. M. B., & Jules, M. A. (2021). Exploring her roots: Black Caribbean hair identity and going natural using social media networks. Journal of Black Psychology, 47(1), 3-30.

This week, we look at the future of communication, including the pitfalls of machine learning and AI. Article to annotate: Sharma, H. (2026). Testing medical AI by fabricating disease: an ethical analysis. Ethics, Medicine and Public Health, 34, 101310.
